in_marathi.name: Ramanji
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ramanji हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who delights in the divine. Derived from the name 'Rama', which means 'Joy, Delight', and the suffix '-anji', which means 'one who is'.

in_bengali.name: Ramanji

in_bengali.long_meaning: Ramanji একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। One who delights in the divine. Derived from the name 'Rama', which means 'Joy, Delight', and the suffix '-anji', which means 'one who is'.
